            THE WORK

            Jobs are on the board, top right.

            Jobs are on the board, behind the WORK button.

            Take one and it tells you where to go and what to do when you get there. Fuel and armour come back over your own pad and nowhere else.

            Every job moves somebody's opinion of you. You will not stay neutral, and you are not supposed to.

            THE CONTROLS

            All of them are in the pause menu, on ESC, along with the sound. Nothing is pinned over the game.

            All of them are in the pause menu, behind MENU on the rail, along with the sound.

            THE AIRCRAFT

            WASD
            fly, in screen directions
            MOUSEARROWS
            point the nose, wherever you are flying
            SHIFT
            run the throttle up
            SPACE
            the collective: lift off, and climb
            C
            descend, and hold it to set down
            LEFT MOUSEENTER
            fire the weapon you have selected
            123
            choose the weapon
            E
            hold to winch, scan or mark
            F
            countermeasure flares

            ON FOOT

            Q
            get out where you are parked, and climb back in
            WASD
            walk, with SHIFT to run

            THE THUMBS

            Left thumb flies. Push the stick to the rim and the throttle comes up with it. ▲ ▼ climb and descend — separate buttons from the trigger.

            Right thumb points and shoots: hold AIM · FIRE to shoot, and slide it to point the aircraft — you fly one way and face another. WINCH winches, scans or marks, and FLARE throws countermeasures. Tap a weapon tile to change weapon.

            LAND sets the machine down where you are, and once it is down the same button puts you out on foot. Walk with the left thumb; the button reads BOARD when you are close enough to climb back in.

            THE WORLD

            M
            the region map — drag to pan, and -= zoom it
            B
            the yard: fittings, crew and what they cost
            H
            back to your own pad, wherever you are
            WHEEL-=
            zoom out to eight times the view
            0
            back to the default view
            G
            hide the panels
            /
            the brief: this region, and how the work pays
            ESC
            this menu, and close whatever is open

            THE RAIL

            Down the right edge: the work, the map, the yard, landing and getting out, the way back to your pad, the telemetry, and this menu.

            Pinch the world to pull the camera back to eight times the view. The map pinches and drags too, down to six hundred metres across.
